faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Franklin?

Franklin has the Elf Parade and Tree Lighting on December 3, the Christmas Parade on December 4, free pictures with Santa on December 13 and Franklin Holiday Happening on December 15, plus parades across Southampton County. Each listing links to its host page.
Is the Franklin Christmas Parade free?
Yes. Public parades are free to watch, and the City of Franklin Christmas Parade is listed as free on Friday, December 4, from 7 to 9 pm on Main Street.
Where can kids meet Santa in Franklin?
Families can meet Santa for free at Blackwater Regional Library on December 1 and 9, get free pictures on North Main Street on December 13 and visit Santa's Barn at Gatherings in SoCo on December 18.
Is there a train event near Franklin?
Yes. Polar Express Nostalgic Christmas at the Southampton Ag and Forestry Museum in Courtland is on December 5, with gates open from 4 to 7 pm and a $2 cash admission.
